name: Always The Same Blue Sky...
source:
Due to mysterious circumstances you have been sent to finish studying on a remote Mediterranean island. Sure you're used to moving around, but even you haven't experienced an island quite like this... a girl quite like Kira. 

In an already niche genre of storytelling, Always The Same Blue Sky stands out as a truly unique, seaside adventure; a timeless tale of love, mystery and humanity.

[Taken from the [url=https://gumroad.com/crimsonnight]Gumroad page[/url]]
